description: Use to measure an organisation's cybersecurity maturity or to benchmark it against NIST CSF 2.0. Call without answers to get 39 capabilities in the six CSF functions and the 1-5 levels. Call with a level per capability to get the average per function and an overall maturity level.

answers.description: Question id to maturity level 1-5, e.g. {"gv1": 2, "id1": 3}. Unanswered questions count as level 1.

name: maturity_assessment
title: Cybersecurity maturity assessment (NIST CSF 2.0)
